disorder-name.detail: Amyloid-positive confirmed Alzheimer's disease clinical cohort (n=86). Includes both AD-dementia (n=48) and MCI-AD (n=38) stages. All patients were amyloid PET-positive from the Imperial Amyloid PET Cohort.
disorder-name.supporting_text: "We applied neuroanatomical normative modeling to magnetic resonance imaging from a real-world clinical cohort with confirmed AD (n = 86)."

dataset-of-origin.detail: The Imperial Amyloid PET Cohort (APC), established at Imperial College Healthcare NHS Trust (ICHT) in 2013. Includes all patients seen at the Imperial Memory Clinic who received amyloid PET imaging as part of their diagnostic workup.
dataset-of-origin.supporting_text: "The Imperial Amyloid PET Cohort (APC) was established at Imperial College Healthcare NHS Trust (ICHT) in 2013 and includes all patients seen at the Imperial Memory Clinic and receiving amyloid positron emission tomography (PET) imaging as part of their diagnostic workup"
